expected.text: Jefferies maintained the stock as its top insurance pick with a projected 41% upside.

holdings.why_it_matters: At 1.75% fund weight, the stock detracted -0.277 from fund performance over 3 months following a -15.81% drop.

portfolio.statement: PGIM India Midcap Fund maintains high active weights in Financials (23.2%), Industrials (18.0%), and Consumer Discretionary (15.2%), balancing digital consumer platforms with regional lenders and real estate developers.
interp: Short-term headwinds in real estate and healthcare holdings like Prestige Estates and Mankind Pharma have dragged recent 3-month returns to -3.35%.
Resilience in digital platforms such as Zomato and FSN E-Commerce Ventures has partly cushioned recent midcap corrections.
portfolio.line: A cyclical and consumer-skewed midcap portfolio navigating regulatory and sector-specific drag.

drivers.text: Zomato contributed +0.254 to 3-month returns supported by 13.5% price performance.
Prestige Estates detracted -0.247 despite Q2 pre-sales rising 20% to ₹7,225 crore and beating broker estimates.
Max Financial Services detracted -0.277 following a -15.81% quarterly decline ahead of its Q2 earnings review.

Provisional quarterly deposit expansion exceeding 28% for AU Small Finance Bank.
